common.footer: Yoyo — rent anything from people nearby.

verifyEmail.subject: Confirm your email for Yoyo
verifyEmail.preview: One click and your Yoyo account is ready.
verifyEmail.heading: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.body: Welcome to Yoyo! Confirm that this address is yours, so the people you rent with can reach you.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create a Yoyo account, just ignore this email.

resetPassword.subject: Reset your Yoyo password
resetPassword.preview: Set a new password for your Yoyo account.
resetPassword.heading: Reset your password
resetPassword.body: We got a request to reset the password of your Yoyo account. If it was you, set a new one:
resetPassword.expiry: The link works for 1 hour and only once.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

phoneCode.subject: Your Yoyo phone confirmation code
phoneCode.preview: Enter this code on Yoyo to confirm your phone.
phoneCode.heading: Confirm your phone
phoneCode.body: Enter this code on Yoyo to confirm your phone number:
phoneCode.ignore: If you did not ask for a code, just ignore this email.

listingApproved.subject: Your listing is live on Yoyo
listingApproved.preview: People nearby can now find and rent it.
listingApproved.heading: Your listing is published
listingApproved.body: Good news: “{title}” passed moderation and is now in the Yoyo catalog. People nearby can find it and send you requests.

listingRejected.subject: Your Yoyo listing needs changes
listingRejected.preview: See what to fix and send it again.
listingRejected.heading: Your listing needs a few changes
listingRejected.body: Our moderators could not publish “{title}” yet. Here is why:
listingRejected.next: Fix it and send it for review again; it only takes a moment.

owner.subject: New request for “{title}”
owner.preview: {other} wants to rent it from {start} to {end}.
owner.heading: You have a new booking request
owner.body: {other} would like to rent “{title}” from {start} to {end}. You would get {rent}. Accept or decline within 24 hours, or the request expires.

renter.subject: Your request for “{title}” was accepted
renter.preview: Sign the contract and pay to confirm the booking.
renter.heading: Your booking is accepted
renter.body: {other} accepted your request for “{title}” from {start} to {end}. Sign the rental contract and pay {total} (deposit {deposit} included) to confirm it.

renter.subject: Your request for “{title}” was declined
renter.preview: The days are free for other items.
renter.heading: Your request was declined
renter.body: {other} cannot rent out “{title}” from {start} to {end}. Nothing was charged. Have a look at similar items nearby.

renter.subject: The booking of “{title}” is cancelled
renter.preview: Anything you paid goes back the way you paid.
renter.heading: The booking is cancelled
renter.body: The booking of “{title}” from {start} to {end} was cancelled. If you had paid, all of it, the fee included, goes back the way you paid.

owner.subject: The booking of “{title}” is cancelled
owner.heading: The booking is cancelled
owner.body: The booking of “{title}” from {start} to {end} with {other} was cancelled. The days are free again in your calendar.

renter.subject: Your booking of “{title}” expired
renter.preview: The time to answer or pay ran out.
renter.heading: The booking expired
renter.body: The booking of “{title}” from {start} to {end} expired: the time to answer or to pay ran out. Nothing was charged.

owner.subject: The booking of “{title}” expired
owner.heading: The booking expired
owner.body: The booking of “{title}” from {start} to {end} with {other} expired: the time to answer or to pay ran out. The days are free again.

owner.subject: “{title}” is paid: meet {other}
owner.preview: The rent is held by Yoyo until the handover.
owner.heading: The booking is paid
owner.body: {other} paid for “{title}” from {start} to {end}. Yoyo holds the rent, {rent}, until the handover. Agree on a place and time in the chat and mark the handover in Yoyo when you meet.

renter.subject: Did you get “{title}”?
renter.preview: Confirm you received it, or tell us if you did not.
renter.heading: Confirm the handover
renter.body: {other} marked “{title}” as handed over. Confirm that you got it, or report it if you did not. If you do nothing for 48 hours, the handover counts as confirmed.

owner.subject: Handover confirmed: {rent} is in your wallet
owner.heading: The rental has started
owner.body: The handover of “{title}” is confirmed and the rent, {rent}, is in your Yoyo wallet. The item comes back by {end}.

renter.subject: The rental of “{title}” has started
renter.heading: The rental has started
renter.body: The handover of “{title}” is confirmed. Enjoy it, and return it by {end}. Mark the return in Yoyo when you give it back.

owner.subject: {other} returned “{title}”
owner.heading: Did you get the item back?
owner.body: {other} marked “{title}” as returned. Confirm that you got it back, or report it if you did not. If you do nothing for 48 hours, the return counts as confirmed.

renter.subject: “{title}” is back with the owner
renter.preview: The owner now checks it; then the deposit comes back.
renter.heading: The item is back
renter.body: The return of “{title}” is confirmed. The owner has 48 hours to check it; if all is fine, your deposit of {deposit} comes back the way you paid.

owner.subject: Check “{title}” within 48 hours
owner.preview: Report any damage now, or the deposit goes back.
owner.heading: Check the item
owner.body: The return of “{title}” is confirmed. Check it within 48 hours: if it is damaged, report it with photos; otherwise the deposit of {deposit} goes back to {other}.

renter.subject: Your deposit for “{title}” is on its way back
renter.heading: The deal is complete
renter.body: All is fine with “{title}”. Your deposit of {deposit} goes back the way you paid. Thank you for renting with Yoyo, and leave {other} a review.

owner.subject: The deal for “{title}” is complete
owner.preview: The deposit went back to the renter.
owner.heading: The deal is complete
owner.body: The deal for “{title}” with {other} is complete and the deposit of {deposit} went back to them. Leave {other} a review.

renter.subject: The owner reports damage to “{title}”
renter.heading: Damage reported
renter.body: {other} reports damage to “{title}” and asks for the deposit of {deposit}. Look at the photos and agree or disagree within 48 hours; if you do not answer, a Yoyo administrator decides.

owner.subject: The deposit for “{title}” is yours
owner.preview: The renter agreed with the damage claim.
owner.heading: The deposit is yours
owner.body: {other} agreed with your damage claim for “{title}”. The deposit of {deposit} is in your Yoyo wallet.

admins.subject: Dispute to decide: “{title}”
admins.preview: A deal is waiting for an administrator.
admins.heading: A dispute needs a decision
admins.body: The deal for “{title}” ({start} – {end}) went to a dispute. Look at the deal history, photos and chat and decide.

owner.subject: A dispute about “{title}” was opened
owner.heading: A dispute was opened
owner.body: The deal for “{title}” with {other} went to a dispute. A Yoyo administrator will look at the history, photos and chat and decide. The money stays with Yoyo until then.

renter.subject: A dispute about “{title}” was opened
renter.heading: A dispute was opened
renter.body: The deal for “{title}” with {other} went to a dispute. A Yoyo administrator will look at the history, photos and chat and decide. The money stays with Yoyo until then.

renter.subject: The dispute about “{title}” is decided
renter.preview: See the decision and where the money went.
renter.heading: The dispute is decided
renter.body: A Yoyo administrator decided the dispute about “{title}”. Open the deal to see the decision and where the money went.

owner.subject: The dispute about “{title}” is decided
owner.preview: See the decision and where the money went.
owner.heading: The dispute is decided
owner.body: A Yoyo administrator decided the dispute about “{title}”. Open the deal to see the decision and where the money went.

owner.subject: {other} offers {price} a day for “{title}”
owner.heading: A new price offer
owner.body: {other} would rent “{title}” from {start} to {end} for {price} a day. Accept or decline within 24 hours.

renter.subject: Your offer for “{title}” was accepted
renter.heading: Your offer was accepted
renter.body: {other} accepted {price} a day for “{title}” from {start} to {end}. Send the booking request with this offer before the first day.

renter.subject: Your offer for “{title}” was declined
renter.preview: You can still book at the listed price.
renter.heading: Your offer was declined
renter.body: {other} declined {price} a day for “{title}”. You can still book it at the listed price.
